summary: Quiet hillside road, bush opposite, nearest house about 30 m, no parking convention.
reasons: Bush opposite, houses 30 m or more away

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the east side; west side is a grass verge and hedged driveways, nearest mapped house 32 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane; a grass and dirt verge on the west looks wide enough to pull off but is unclear under trees.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential hillside road; no lane markings in the section, occasional local traffic.
drivers.convention: No signs; no cars parked on the road in either image.

flags: Steep: 10.9% mean grade and 31.6% max over the whole stretch; about 3% in the best section
sun_shade: Mostly shaded by bush canopy from the east and tree cover along the verge; open to the west at the driveway.
cannot_judge: Whether the verge is firm enough for a van

best_section.where: west verge north of the grand driveway loop, before the next bend
